data.title: Cramer says Nvidia has become 'all-important' to the AI trade. Here's what to watch beyond the numbers
data.description: CNBC's Jim Cramer said Nvidia has become so central to the AI ecosystem that its earnings are effectively a referendum on the entire AI trade.
data.author: Alexa LoMonaco
